title: Dramebaaj
overview: A shy and modest struggling theatre actor from an affluent family suffers from MPD. As his different personalities come into play, his life goes topsy turvy, creating comical situations and changing his status quo with everyone around.

songs.title: Aape Jo Chocolate
songs.singers: Bhargav Purohit, Meet Jain, Hiral Brahmbhatt, Kedar Upadhyay
